question: Is frozen shipping-NS ns_noise_rms_dbfs, observed causally at the first pre-ready-speech disagreement frame, faithful enough to represent the same target case's later ordinary-noise state before any donor normalization rule is designed?

fixed_shipping_semantics.causal_noise_scale_provenance: direct field from ap_ns_process shipping NS result; not diagnostic VAD state

frozen_donor_selection.ordering: lexicographically minimize [scenario_group_mismatch, reverb_mismatch, snr_missing_penalty, absolute_snr_distance, exact_scenario_mismatch, case_key]

frozen_donor_control.rule: For K=3 selected donor cases, use the component-wise median of each donor case first-ready summary for mean, concentration and gap exactly as in I030/I031.
frozen_donor_control.noise_scale_summary: For descriptive mismatch only, use the median donor first-ready ns_noise_rms_dbfs across the same frozen K=3 selected donors.

causal_proxy_semantics.trigger: first oracle-speech disagreement frame for which fewer than eight same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement references have previously accumulated
causal_proxy_semantics.proxy: ns_noise_rms_dbfs on that exact target frame

retrospective_benchmark_semantics.benchmark: median ns_noise_rms_dbfs over the first eight ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames strictly after the causal target frame
retrospective_benchmark_semantics.role: retrospective fidelity benchmark only; never a causal input or normalization source
retrospective_benchmark_semantics.gap_benchmark: median mirror_gap over the same eight later frames, used only for descriptive frozen-donor transfer error

fidelity_hypothesis.primary_population: target cases with at least one causal pre-ready-speech target and at least eight later ordinary-noise non-disagreement reference frames
fidelity_hypothesis.primary_metric: absolute error in dB between causal ns_noise_rms_dbfs and later eight-frame median ns_noise_rms_dbfs

descriptive_transfer_association.x: absolute difference between frozen K=3 donor noise-scale summary and causal target ns_noise_rms_dbfs
descriptive_transfer_association.y: absolute frozen donor gap error versus later target gap benchmark

diagnostic_outputs: per-target causal pre-ready-speech frame index and prior reference count
causal proxy signed and absolute dB error
median and nearest-rank p90 absolute error
frozen donor noise-scale mismatch versus causal target noise scale
frozen donor gap transfer error against later target gap benchmark
descriptive Spearman association and mismatch quartiles
coverage and exact shipping mirror identity

decision_contract.NS_UPSTREAM_TARGET_CAUSAL_NOISE_SCALE_OB: Fresh donor/target authority, frozen donor rule/control, causal shipping-NS proxy capture, strictly post-target benchmark, coverage and shipping mirrors are valid. Report fidelity and descriptive transfer association for review without selecting a normalization mapping or candidate.
decision_contract.I032_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, frozen-input identity, donor/target disjointness, causal target count, post-target benchmark coverage, donor coverage or shipping-mirror preconditions fail.

next_review: Use I032 only to determine whether the existing target-side shipping NS noise-scale state is a faithful causal observable. Any normalization mapping, donor adaptation rule, reference-source candidate, component counterfactual or shipping change requires a new independently preregistered authority.
